judge.system: You compare a writing task with an earlier note by the same author and say how they relate. Answer with one word.
judge.user_template:
Task (what the author was asked to write about):
{brief}

Earlier note by the same author:
{note}

The task and the earlier note both come from an account that writes about AI, so being about AI, or about the same broad field, is not a connection.

How does the earlier note relate to the task?
SAME: it is about the same specific story, event, announcement or claim as the task, so the author could sensibly build on it or refer back to it.
RELATED: it is about the same specific subject, entity or question, but the task makes a different point.
UNRELATED: otherwise.
Answer with exactly one word: SAME, RELATED or UNRELATED.
judge.user_template_reversed:
Task (what the author was asked to write about):
{brief}

Earlier note by the same author:
{note}

The task and the earlier note both come from an account that writes about AI, so being about AI, or about the same broad field, is not a connection.

How does the earlier note relate to the task?
UNRELATED: neither of the two descriptions below.
RELATED: it is about the same specific subject, entity or question, but the task makes a different point.
SAME: it is about the same specific story, event, announcement or claim as the task, so the author could sensibly build on it or refer back to it.
Answer with exactly one word: SAME, RELATED or UNRELATED.
judge.prompt_sha256_of: sha256 of system + two newlines + user_template (UTF-8); the reversed one likewise with user_template_reversed

p1.helps: lower bound of D_emb > 0 and D_emb >= margin
p1.sufficient: upper bounds of D_emb and D_hyb < margin

p1b.role: fusion check; qualifies the recommendation when D_hyb < D_emb / 2; never decides EMBEDDER_HELPS_GATE
